name: Treehouse – space-net between two large trees
notes: Space-net style treehouse slung between two large trees in the north-east corner, in place of the B4 building pad (about 117 m, north-west facing spur). Before building: arborist check of both trees (health, limbs, root zone), attach with tree-friendly fixings that allow growth; the spur is exposed to wind and to fire running upslope, so keep a low-fuel clearing under it and a safe access path. Drag the point to the actual trees.
